data.content_ref: inline:The problem asks 'What is the number of pieces produced?' expecting a determinate answer. SRC_001 refuses to give one, offering a range instead, on the grounds that cuts might not be distinct. But a standard mathematical reading of '4 straight cuts' implies four distinct cuts; otherwise the phrase '4 cuts' would be vacuous. By treating coincident cuts as a live possibility worth withholding an answer over, SRC_001 fails to answer the problem as posed.
